requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "New Employee Onboarding Guide"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Welcome to Moa Logistics"}, {"id": 2, "text": "This document guides you through your first 2 weeks step-by-step ▶"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "문의는 인사팀 변준호(Joonho Byun) 매니저에게 하면 됩니다."}, {"id": 1, "text": "개발 환경 설정은 엄서진(Seojin Um) 님이 도와 드립니다."}, {"id": 2, "text": "첫날"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Upon arrival, please first receive your access card at the 1st floor information desk."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Received the access card, and Junho Manager registers it."}, {"id": 1, "text": "The seat is next to the dawn team, and Eom Seojin also sits in the same row."}, {"id": 2, "text": "We will eat lunch with the team members."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Second day"}, {"id": 1, "text": "On the second day, you spend the whole day on-site."}, {"id": 2, "text": "The disembarking work is observed while wearing safety shoes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Do not speak to the equipment while working."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The experience report is submitted for approval to Team Manager."}, {"id": 1, "text": "It will be delivered to Junho Manager upon confirmation."}, {"id": 2, "text": "First week"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "New Moores Logistics hires will complete the 'Launchpad' task list during their first week."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Launchpad 1 is wiki login and internal messenger registration."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Company announcements and casual conversation are made in the 'Hearth' channel."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Platform 2 is for taking the guide training for the car dispatch system."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Try making a daily dispatch plan yourself as the guide."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Do not upload the practice screen to Hearth."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The report doesn't need to be long."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Once the deliverables are completed, you'll start working on real projects from the second week."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Your first practical session will be a code review with Ms. Eumseojin."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "After finishing the footrest, you'll start working on real projects from the second week. The first real project is a code review with Mr. Kim. The code review results will be shared in the 'Mo-dakbul' team channel."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Ask any questions at any time to Manager Byeon Joonho."},{"id": 1, "text": "Finally, leave a one-line comment about the campfire and that's it."}]}
